title: Voice Idol Maniacs: Pool Bar Story
native_title: ボイス・アイドル・マニアックス ～プール・バー・ストーリー～
overview: Voice Idol Maniacs: Pool Bar Story is a top-down billiards game similar to Data East's own Side Pocket, where the eight opponents are all popular voice actresses. There are three game modes: Date mode allows the player to select any opponent and game type and play rounds, unlocking video clips of that girl as games are won; Tournament mode has the player compete against each opponent in order in a specific game type; and Trick mode tasks the player with sinking all the balls in 16 different trick shot setups.
